latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: FreeRide skill for OpenClaw

- Adds skill to manage free AI models from OpenRouter, including automated ranking and fallback configuration.
- Provides commands to list, switch, and set up free AI models, preserving user configuration.
- Offers troubleshooting tips and installation instructions.
- Includes an optional watcher script for automatic model rotation on rate limit.
- Updates README and documentation for user-oriented setup and usage.
